values.note: Camping is paid at the self-pay kiosk by contactless card only (no cash or cheques), or at the visitor center. The $25 vehicle entrance pass covers 7 days; the $55 annual pass covers Lava Beds, Whiskeytown, Lassen and Crater Lake. Read 2026-11-27.

values.note: Self-registration at the kiosk within 30 minutes of taking a site. The campground usually fills only on summer weekends near holidays; when it is full, staff point campers to campgrounds within 30 minutes and to dispersed camping on the Modoc National Forest just south. Only the tent-only group site books on recreation.gov.

note: Lava Beds National Monument's only developed campground, in juniper and sagebrush half a mile from the visitor center and the Cave Loop. Loop A stays open all winter and Loop B closes after Thanksgiving. Caving needs a free permit from the visitor center. --Claude
summary: NPS API (campgrounds/parks/alerts) + nps.gov regulations + rec.gov facility/rates/catalog read. $20 all year, FCFS only (kiosk, contactless card only), 43 sites, motorhomes/trailers to 30 ft at a few sites, no hookups/showers/dump; A loop year-round, B loop closes after Thanksgiving; $25/vehicle 7-day entrance; Senior/Access 50%. Not waterfront (unchanged). Pin within ~35 m of the NPS point.
flags: FIT CAVEAT: NPS says the campground is 'designed primarily for tent camping but small (less than 35 ft long) RV and trailers can be accommodated at a few sites' and 'not all sites can accommodate motor homes'. A 23-ft rig fits under the 30-ft limit; with first-come only and few RV-capable spurs, arriving early on a summer weekend matters. Not a drop.

ENTRANCE: $25 per vehicle for 7 days is charged on top of camping ('An entrance pass is required in the park and while staying in the campground'); written as entrance per vehicle_stay with the $55 4-park annual pass. Lava Beds is not one of the 11 parks with the $100 non-resident surcharge in the federal:nps row.
PHONE: 530-667-8113 unchanged (NPS posted a Nov 4-5, 2026 phone outage; email labe_information@nps.gov). WEBSITE unchanged.
PAYMENT: contactless 'Tap' card only at the kiosk - no cash or cheques (in fees.note).
